title: Daily Market Digest: August 10, 2026
subtitle: US Markets Close Higher, S&P 500 Hits Record High Amid Weak Jobs Data and Strong Earnings

items.headline: Wall Street rallies as S&P 500 achieves new record close
items.summary: U.S. equities finished Monday, August 10, 2026, on a strong note, with the S&P 500 reaching an all-time high. The positive sentiment was primarily driven by weaker-than-expected July jobs data, which significantly lowered expectations for a Federal Reserve rate hike in September, alongside a robust corporate earnings season. All major indices recorded gains, underscoring broad market optimism. Not financial advice.

items.headline: Weak July Jobs Report Eases Rate Hike Fears
items.summary: The U.S. economy unexpectedly shed 23,000 nonfarm payroll jobs in July, significantly below the 80,000 increase economists anticipated. This weaker-than-expected data led to a reduction in market expectations for a September Federal Reserve interest rate hike, falling to approximately 44%. The unemployment rate also slightly decreased to 4.1% from 4.2% in June.

items.headline: Strong Corporate Earnings Drive Market Rally
items.summary: The current earnings season continues to be robust, with 85.1% of S&P 500 companies reporting results through Friday morning surpassing analyst expectations. Overall, 87% of S&P 500 companies have beaten bottom-line estimates and 69% have exceeded top-line expectations for Q2. This strong performance, particularly from AI-related investments, is a key factor in the ongoing market rally.

items.headline: Technology and Materials Lead as Energy Lags
items.summary: Technology stocks continued their strong performance, contributing significantly to the broader market's gains. The information technology and materials sectors led overall performance last week. Conversely, the energy sector was the sole laggard, ending the week in the red.

items.headline: J.P. Morgan Raises S&P 500 Year-End Target to 8,000
items.summary: J.P. Morgan revised its year-end target for the S&P 500 to 8,000, citing powerful corporate earnings and the anticipated revenue growth from AI investments by hyperscalers. This new target suggests a potential upside of approximately 3.12% from Friday's closing level.

items.headline: Upcoming Inflation Data in Focus for the Week Ahead
items.summary: Investors will closely monitor key inflation data scheduled for release later this week, including the Consumer Price Index (CPI) on Wednesday and the Producer Price Index (PPI) on Thursday. July's CPI is projected to have increased by 3.4%, slightly easing from 3.5% in June. These reports will provide further insights into inflation trends as the Federal Reserve evaluates its monetary policy.

items.headline: Several Companies Report Earnings Today, August 10th
items.summary: A number of companies are scheduled to release their earnings reports today, August 10, 2026. Notable names include Rocket Lab ($RKLB), AST SpaceMobile ($ASTS), Plug Power ($PLUG), Hims & Hers Health ($HIMS), and monday.com ($MNDY), among others.
